name: Gunavatta Evam Navaachar Nishulk Paathy Pustak Yojana
briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free textbooks to all students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in government and government-aided schools, as well as recognized madrasas that follow the state government curriculum.
descriptionMd: The scheme "Gunavatta Evam Navaachar Nishulk Paathy Pustak" is a scheme under the Samagra Shiksha Programme, implemented by the Secondary Education Department, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free textbooks to all students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in government and government-aided schools, as well as recognized madrasas that follow the state government curriculum.
benefitsMd: Every year, in accordance with the guidelines of the Directorate of Elementary and Secondary Education, free textbooks are provided to all students from Classes 1 to 8 in government schools, government-aided schools, and recognized madrasas following the state government curriculum.
eligibilityMd: 1. The applicant must be a student from Classes 1 to 8. 1. The applicant must be studying in a government or government-aided school, or a recognized madrasa that follows the Uttarakhand state government curriculum.
applicationMd: There is no selection process. Textbooks are distributed free of cost to all students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in the eligible schools.
